title: Savings Account MAB
content: Maintain the monthly average balance (MAB) by keeping your daily closing balance above the threshold. Falling short can trigger a service fee.

title: Debit Card Blocking
content: You can block a lost or stolen debit card instantly via mobile banking or the helpline. A digital replacement card is issued in minutes.

title: UPI Daily Limits
content: UPI payments are capped at INR 1 lakh per day for most customers. Merchants may set lower limits for security. Common queries include phrases like 'limit kitna hai' or 'UPI limit kitna'.

title: EMI Formula
content: EMI is calculated using P*r*(1+r)^n divided by ((1+r)^n - 1) where P is principal, r is monthly rate, and n is tenure in months.

title: NEFT Timings
content: NEFT transfers run 24x7 in half-hour batches. Credits may take up to 2 hours depending on the beneficiary bank.

title: KYC Update
content: Update KYC every two years with proof of identity and address. Use the mobile app to upload scans or visit any branch.

title: FD Interest Payout
content: Fixed deposits offer monthly, quarterly, or cumulative payout. Premature closure attracts a 1% lower rate.

title: Credit Card Billing Cycle
content: Your credit card billing cycle lasts 30 days with a 20-day grace period. Pay the total due to avoid interest.

title: Statement Request
content: Download statements for the last 24 months from internet banking. Older copies can be emailed on request.

title: Two-Factor Authentication
content: Online transactions require two-factor authentication via OTP or device binding for enhanced security.
